description.value:
Requirements Continuation; your immediately preceding action this turn was a successful Gnashing Fang Strike against an enemy still in your melee reach. Frequency once per round, shared by all Continuation follow-ups.

Trigger a close-range aetheric discharge against that enemy: deal 2d6 fire damage, increasing to 3d6 at 11th level and 4d6 at 17th. No attack roll or save is required because the preceding Strike established the hit. This is separate damage and never doubles on a critical hit. Consume the opening.

@Damage[(2+floor((@actor.level-5)/6))d6[fire]]
